_doc: Local transport vectors for docs/remote/helper-protocol.md section 15. Read by helper/tests/fixtures.rs and tests/unit/scripts/helper-fixtures.test.ts. A vector tagged os applies on that OS only (windows, or unix for macOS and Linux); untagged ones apply on every OS. Requests are read as a connection that acked local reads them; a record or listing that is valid re-encodes to the same bytes.
